sentences.en: The medieval church despised the body and exalted the spirit.

sentences.en: Slavic lands were referred to as Canaan in Medieval Hebrew.

sentences.en: Is early medieval glass production a continuation of Roman glass technology?
sentences.zh: 早期中世纪的玻璃生产是否延续了罗马玻璃技术？

senses.zh: 中世纪的（约公元476年—公元1453年）
